text: Grouped-split AUC is lower than per-row AUC by more than one CV standard deviation.
author: lead
mechanism: Rows repeated across train and test leak scenario identity into the test fold.
distinguishing_prediction: GroupKFold by scenario lowers AUC; per-row KFold does not.
strongest_alternative: The repeats are exact duplicates with identical labels, so both splits agree.
undermining_observation: Grouped and per-row AUC differ by less than one CV standard deviation.
